text:
maria: Quick FYI — after merging #2180 into instr-pipeline I'm seeing token-cost attribution shift for embeddings (~3-4% higher cost). Not sure if it's a mapping bug or an off-by-one in the schema. Can owners triage? :eyes:

aj: Rough repro? a query or batch that shows the delta?

maria: Query I used to compare: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_events WHERE model='embed-xx' AND day='2026-03-16';`
The delta surfaces in the `cost_bucket` tag between v2.3.0 and v2.3.1. Log excerpt below:

```json
{
  "event": "token_emit",
  "model": "embed-xx",
  "tokens": 120,
  "tags": { "cost_bucket": "embeddings_v1" }
}
```

lina: Pinging analytics. I'll take point and file a tracking ticket (INSTR-412). Can you paste the pipeline config/version?

maria: Prod pipeline is `instr-pipeline v2.3.1` — config snippet: 

```yaml
pipeline: instr-ingest
version: 2.3.1
transformers:
  - name: cost-tag-mapper
    map_rules: ref: repo/ops/cost-maps/v1.yaml
```

chen: Heads-up — there's a downstream consumer (billing pipeline) that expects `cost_type` enum. If `cost_bucket` changes names we risk misclassification. PR #2199 was blocked on this.

sam: I'll pick up review on #2199 in the next hour. Need unit tests for the mapping function though.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to eu-west-1 with commit abc123 — initial health checks OK, no errors in first 30m.

maria: Thanks. I added a short smoke test to the integration harness: 

```bash
# smoke: assert no change in cost attribution >1% for sample customer set
curl -s -X POST https://ci.internal/run-smoke -d '{"suite":"instr-cost-smoke","ref":"abc123"}'
```

lina: Running smoke on canary now. Will report results in ~20m.

aj: If smoke fails, can we rollback to v2.3.0 easily? What's the rollback play?

ops-bot: Rollback template (internal): `kubectl set image deployment/instr-pipeline instr=registry/redwood/instr-pipeline:v2.3.0` — see runbook: https://runbook/internal/deploys #runbook-deploys

chen: If we need to freeze, we should notify billing & finance. I just pinged @finance in their channel.

sam: Left comments on #2199 about adding coverage for edge-case customer ids and the enum mapping.

lina: Local smoke passed; canary still shows ~3% shift but it's concentrated on customers with legacy tags. Marking INSTR-412 as "investigating" and adding sample customer ids.

maria: OK — next steps: lina to root cause and propose mapping fix, sam to add tests and review, aj/chen to validate downstream consumer behavior. Aim to resolve by EOD. :thumbsup:
